$schema.description: Relative path or URL to the JSON schema definition file.

specsDir.description: Path to the directory containing feature specifications. Supports token {projectRoot}.

scoreMin.description: Minimum conformance score (0-10) required before creating delivery commits.

scmCodeReviewEnabled.description: Enable remote pull request review polling loop and automated review comment resolution.

pushDelivery.description: Automatically push the delivery commit and branch to remote origin upon workflow completion.

stateDir.description: Path to the directory storing run session state files. Supports token {projectRoot}.

autoResolveGaps.description: Automatically apply recommended defaults for unhandled grilling gaps when running non-interactively.

requiredBuild.description: Enforce successful build verification in Step 8 before creating delivery commit or PR.

buildCommand.description: Command to execute for build verification.

runAllTests.description: Enforce passing all test suites in Step 8 before creating delivery commit or PR.

testCommand.description: Command to execute for test verification pass.

prePrCommand.description: Optional project-specific shell command to execute before PR preparation (e.g. version bump, lint).

prePrInstructions.description: Optional project-specific instructions or checklist for agents to verify prior to PR submission.
